# semantic-mutant: a5d83d760dbc5183
from __future__ import annotations

import pytest
from pydantic import BaseModel

from llm_router._internal.capabilities import normalize_schema, validate_schema_output

pytestmark = pytest.mark.verification_kind("unit")


class WeatherReport(BaseModel):
    city: str
    temperature_c: int


@pytest.mark.verifies("REQ_STRUCTURED_SCHEMA_CONTRACT[revision==2]")
def test_pydantic_schema_reconstructs_model_from_mapping_output() -> None:
    spec = normalize_schema(WeatherReport)
    payload = {"city": "Lisbon", "temperature_c": 21}

    assert spec.model_type is WeatherReport
    assert dict(spec.json_schema) == WeatherReport.model_json_schema()

    parsed = spec.parse(payload)
    assert isinstance(parsed, WeatherReport)
    assert parsed == WeatherReport(city="Lisbon", temperature_c=21)

    result = validate_schema_output(spec, payload)
    assert result.valid is True
    assert result.error_message is None
    assert isinstance(result.value, WeatherReport)
    assert result.value.city == "Lisbon"
    assert result.value.temperature_c == 21
